Taken, with my judgment of each: rulings add no theme (right); the bags not cut (mostly right, at a cost at C1); my D4 amendments reverted (right on procedure, costly in substance; the D3 amendment leg I named at D3c was not taken); the room forms designed by J (partly right: forms the facets did not give, but leans of a continuum); no second coder and no further readers after three requests (defensible, costly; local validation not established); kind not relied on (right); fixed thresholds (mostly right for this design). Where the handling was right and I was wrong: A1's reading route, the unit at C5, the kind of a line, the forms' placement and count, the D6a-04 rule, the medoid, RETURN-E1.md without reading the trailer, the E1 route word.
